text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them catch problems early and design cleaner solutions. Although writing tests takes extra time, it brings real benefits. Good tests give developers confidence that their changes will not break existing features. As a result, teams can improve their software faster and with less stress, knowing that problems are found before users see them.
